_transfer invokes swapBack when the swap thresholds are satisfied.
swapBack swaps accumulated tokens for ETH through the router.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet with a low-level call.
swapBack forwards the remaining ETH to marketingWallet with a low-level call.
swapBack adds liquidity through the router before finishing distributions.
The low-level call to devWallet can re-enter _transfer while swapping state is transient.
The low-level call to marketingWallet can re-enter _transfer before state settles.

The router swap triggers token transfer hooks back into this contract.

The liquidity call transfers tokens back through _transfer.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens performs an external pair.sync().
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens performs an external pair.sync().
pair.sync() is an external call that can interact with the token balances.
_transfer triggers the automatic LP burn when the timestamp condition holds.
The swapping guard is checked in _transfer to block nested swapBack.
